title: Bounded-below cohomology comparison
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a ring, and $\nu_X:X_{\mathrm{proét}}\to X_{\mathrm{ét}}$
the comparison morphism. For $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{ét}},\Lambda)$ the unit of the
adjunction between
$\nu_X^*:D^+(X_{\mathrm{ét}},\Lambda)\to D^+(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ and
$R\nu_{X,*}$ is an isomorphism

$$
K\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }R\nu_{X,*}\nu_X^*K\quad\text{in }D^+(X_{\mathrm{ét}},\Lambda).
$$

Consequently $\nu_X^*:D^+(X_{\mathrm{ét}},\Lambda)\to D^+(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ is
fully faithful, and there is a canonical isomorphism in the derived category
of $\Lambda$-modules

$$
R\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\nu_X^*K)\simeq R\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{ét}},K).
$$

More generally, for a pro-étale affine $U=\varprojlim_iU_i$ with $U_i$
affine and étale over $X$,

$$
R\Gamma(U_{\mathrm{proét}},(\nu_X^*K)|_U)\simeq
\varinjlim_iR\Gamma((U_i)_{\mathrm{ét}},K|_{U_i}).
$$

The colimit here is a filtered derived colimit, so its cohomology is the
filtered colimit of the cohomology groups.

proof.text:
Choose a bounded-below injective resolution $I^\bullet$ of $K$. By
[sk-lem-pe-injective-acyclicity], $\nu_X^*I^\bullet$ is a resolution by
$\nu_{X,*}$-acyclic sheaves, so applying $\nu_{X,*}$ termwise computes
$R\nu_{X,*}\nu_X^*K$. The underived unit is an isomorphism on every term, so
this complex is $I^\bullet$, which proves that the derived unit
$K\to R\nu_{X,*}\nu_X^*K$ is an isomorphism (Stacks, Tag 099V). Full
faithfulness follows by adjunction. Composing derived right adjoints,
$R\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{proét}},-)=R\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{ét}},-)\circ R\nu_{X,*}$, gives
the statement on global sections (Stacks, Tag 099W).

For the affine formula, apply the global sections statement to $U$ and then
continuity of étale cohomology under affine limits (Stacks, Tag 03Q6). This
gives the formula in each degree for a sheaf. For a bounded-below complex
only finitely many terms of the hypercohomology spectral sequence contribute
to each total degree, and filtered colimits are exact.
